title: `ResourceLoader.load_threaded_request` with `use_sub_threads = true` fails to load external resources or crashes
body:
### Tested versions

Tested and confirmed in:
- 4.6.1
- 4.6.2

### System information

Godot v4.6.2.stable - macOS Tahoe (26.4.0) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - Metal (Mobile) - integrated Apple M3 Max (Apple9) - Apple M3 Max (14 threads) - 36.00 GiB memory

### Issue description

My team and I are running into a big issue with `ResourceLoader.load_threaded_request` when `use_sub_threads` is set to `true` (which drastically reduces loading times). Attempting to load one of Hidden Folks 2's larger WIP scenes with ±6000 objects which are instantiated from maybe ±1000 PackedScenes, a lot of PackedScenes (and the CompressedTextures2D that are its dependencies) fail to load.

This issue can be reproduced fairly consistently in our project with the following three results:
- The game spawns massive errors (always when running the first time, and otherwise 20% of the time). See below
- The game crashes (70% of the time).
- The game runs as expected (10% of the time). 

When we set `use_sub_threads` to `false`, the game runs as expected 100% of the time. Setting a different `cache_mode` doesn't make a difference.

If the game spawns errors, the logs contain three distinct sections. The first section spawns thousands of errors like this one:

And then the third section spawns thousands of errors like these:
```

   at: instantiate (scene/resources/packed_scene.cpp:290)
   GDScript backtrace (most recent call first):

   at: instantiate (scene/resources/packed_scene.cpp:211)
   GDScript backtrace (most recent call first):
       [0] _instantiate_next_scene (res://application/scene_manager.gd:119)
       [1] _process (res://application/scene_manager.gd:76)
[…]
```

We've only observed this issue on macOS and Windows and not on Linux, but this could be a red herring by being related to the linux setup we tested on.

### Steps to reproduce

Load a `PackedScene` with a dependency on more than a thousand PackedScenes using `ResourceLoader.load_threaded_request()` with `use_sub_threads` set to true.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

We've not been able to make an MRP yet. I'll continue to dig and see if I can make one, but as I did with Rift Riff previously, I will happily share source code access with familiar Godot contributors. Talk to me on RocketChat.
